title: Battle of Hsimucheng
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Hsimucheng", at revision 1370443278, opens: "The Battle of Hsimucheng was a minor land engagement of the Russo-Japanese War. It was fought on 31 July 1904 near Hsimucheng, a hamlet in today's Ximu Town about 20 kilometres southeast of the strategic junction town of Haicheng, on the main road connecting Haicheng with the coast between elements of the Imperial Japanese Army and the Imperial Russian Army." Wikidata item Q2409166, whose own description reads "1904 minor engagement of the Russo-Japanese War". That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does.
